data.one_liner: Flutter UI library for building chat and AI assistant interfaces
data.what_it_does: Flow UI provides a collection of ready‑made widgets for chat surfaces, message threads, composers, attachments, and theming. It supports streaming text, file picking, and a consistent design system.
use_when: You need a production‑grade chat UI with built‑in theming and attachment support
You want to quickly prototype an AI assistant interface
You prefer a declarative widget set over custom implementation
avoid_when: You require a stable 1.0+ API with no breaking changes
You need a highly custom design that diverges from the provided theme
You are building a non‑chat UI that only needs generic widgets
strengths: Rich set of chat‑specific widgets (thread, composer, attachments)
Built‑in theming with FlowTheme and Google Fonts
Streaming text and file picker integration
Zero‑state greeting and side panel support
weaknesses: Pre‑1.0, API may change with minor releases
Requires network for Google Fonts on first use
data.setup_notes: Add flow_ui to pubspec, optionally add FlowTheme to MaterialApp. On Android add INTERNET permission, on macOS add network entitlement. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: flutter_chat_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar chat UI but with a stable 1.0+ API and no external font dependency
